n: MIT K12 Maker micro:bit Robot Car and Rover Exploration
t: A project where learners build and code a micro:bit rover that avoids obstacles.
steps: Find the project page from MIT K12 Maker and read the parts list.
Source two hobby motors, a micro:bit V2, a motor board, three photoresistors and an HC-SR04 distance sensor.
Wire the sensors to the board.
Test the rover on a small course.
